oidc.title: OpenID Connect Authentication
oidc.description: Allow users to sign in via an OIDC-compatible identity provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia, Auth0, Okta, etc.).
oidc.enableHint: When enabled and fully configured, the login page will show a button to sign in via your IdP.

oidc.redirectUriLabel: Redirect URI (register this with your identity provider)
oidc.redirectUriHint: Set BASE_URL to your public URL so this value reflects your actual host. The path is fixed.
oidc.issuerUrlHint: The base URL of your IdP. Used for discovery (.well-known/openid-configuration).
oidc.autopopulateTitle: Fetch endpoint URLs from the issuer's discovery document
oidc.discoverFailed: Could not fetch the discovery document.
oidc.endSessionHint: Optional. Redirect users here when they log out, if your IdP supports RP-initiated logout.
oidc.clientSecretPlaceholder: Paste a new secret to set
oidc.clientSecretReplace: Paste a new secret to replace
oidc.buttonTextHint: What the SSO button on the login screen will say.
oidc.groupsClaimHint: Name of the OIDC claim that contains a list of the user's groups (commonly 'groups'). When set, the app assigns roles from membership in groups named (case-insensitively) 'admin', 'gm', or 'player' — highest level wins. If no group matches, access is denied.
oidc.permissionsClaimHint: Name of the OIDC claim containing a permissions object for non-admin users. Currently supports {viewNSFW: bool}. If the claim is missing entirely, access is denied; missing keys default to false.
oidc.matchByHint: On first login, link an existing local account to the OIDC subject by this field. Subsequent logins match by stable subject.
oidc.autoLaunchHint: Redirect to the IdP automatically when visiting the login page. Add ?autoLaunch=0 to bypass.
oidc.autoRegisterHint: Automatically create new local accounts on first OIDC login. Without this, users must already exist locally.
